item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0015-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0015-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0015-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0015-E004","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The February 2023 plenum called for democratic centralism, a clean political environment, continued correction of the Four Winds, investigation-based governance, and an integrated anti-corruption approach described as making corruption impossible, difficult, and undesirable.","notes":["Replaced the unsupported interpretive wording about targeting fear, opportunity, and motivation with the excerpt's stated anti-corruption formulation."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0015-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0015-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0015-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0015-E008","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"In a May 2023 statement, Xi said that in 2013 he put forward the initiative of jointly building the Silk Road Economic Belt in Central Asian countries; he said China–Central Asia cooperation had expanded across fields and delivered benefits to people on both sides, and encouraged students to contribute as builders and ambassadors of the relationship.","notes":["Narrowed “launched” to the excerpt's wording, “put forward the initiative.”"]}]}
